english:
Obtaining Field of Light grants 4%|8%|12%|16%|20% increased Weapon Damage and 30 Resilience for 20 seconds.

The buff is not lost if Field of Light expires and can be refreshed.

Stacks with everything except for the Well of Radiance caster.

source.text:
